text:
Amy: Quick thread  Acme engineering wants clarity before legal call: OEM embedding, SSO provisioning, per-seat vs usage pricing, telemetry defaults, and any IP/redistribution restrictions. Can someone take point?
Darian: I can handle the technical answers. Short summary: SDK is embeddable under OEM license (needs legal signoff). We don't ship weights. Offline cache + proxying to their VPC supported via Private connector.
Priya: Security/legal flags: they asked if we allow redistributing SDK in their installer and whether that constitutes redistribution of our code. Legal needs to confirm license wording. Also need SSO flow details (SAML vs OIDC) and whether we can support Just-in-Time provisioning.
Carlos: Pricing: Two viable POC models: 1) Per-seat flat for device installs + monthly Dedicated backend for steady QPS. 2) Usage-based with per-miss token surcharge. For a short POC, offer a time-limited credit or capped spend.
Amy: They also asked about telemetry: default on or off? They want telemetry off by default for OEM builds. Any issues?
Darian: Telemetry can be disabled at build time via config flag. We recommend an opt-in telemetry endpoint that only sends anonymous metrics (no payload). Example build config: ```json
{"build_flags":{"telemetry_enabled":false,"telemetry_endpoint":"https://telemetry.redwood.example/ingest","allow_local_cache":true},"auth":"api_key"}
```
Priya: SSO notes: we support SAML and OIDC. For OEM deployments, recommend SAML with attribute mapping. We can support SP-initiated SSO and provisioning via SCIM if they need user sync. Need their IdP details to confirm.
Carlos: On per-seat pricing, note sync: per-seat + reserved capacity tends to be easiest for OEM sales teams. Usage surcharge for cache misses should be small. I'll draft two scenarios and mark them provisional.
Amy: IP question from Acme: can they rebrand the SDK UI and ship it as part of their product?
Priya: We typically allow UI customization but not removing attribution required by the license. Legal will advise on acceptable rebranding. Also confirm no model artifacts are redistributed.
Darian: Also technical blocker: if they insist on local model execution (air-gapped), that's out of scope for the hosted SDK. We can discuss Private on-prem package but that's a separate contract.
Amy: Actions: Darian  technical note + minimal sample config for their desktop build. Priya  send security and legal questionnaire and flag rebranding/IP constraints. Carlos  provisional pricing scenarios (per-seat vs usage). I'll schedule a call with Acme for Tue 11am PT.
invite-bot: Event created: "Acme OEM technical & legal sync"  Tue 11:00 AM PT. Invite sent.
Darian: I'll also add an example of cache TTL and eviction best practices for desktop clients before the call.
Priya: Sending questionnaire DM now, will include SCIM capabilities and required compliance artifacts (SOC2, DPA).
Carlos: Adding optional 24/7 support addon and faster SLAs for OEM customers to the quote. :+1:
Amy: Thanks team  please drop drafts into the Acme channel and tag me.
